The focus is on the head, neck, and forelimbs. The background includes a plain wall and a glimpse of a doorframe or furniture leg.

The tip of the visible ear lacks crisp definition and seems to blend slightly into the background/shadows, though this could also be due to depth of field. It feels slightly less structurally rigid than a real photograph.
